summary: Advances a phase accumulator stored in this[3] by the fixed delta dbl_8AFE98, normalizes it by subtracting the floor (via CRTFtol) scaled by 60.0, and only when the result is >= 0.2 evaluates a six-segment amplitude envelope over a 4.0-unit cycle. Each active segment calls TimerClockFormat(amplitude, segment) with an amplitude of 1.0 or a linear ramp, and a per-segment flag (1 or 0). Returns void after the first matching segment.

operations.description: Advance the phase accumulator: this[3] = dbl_8AFE98 + this[3].
Normalize the phase: v2 = this[3] - (double)CRTFtol(this[3]) * 60.0, i.e. subtract the floor of the accumulator scaled by 60.0.
Gate on v2 >= 0.2: below 0.2 the function produces no output and returns.
Normalize the cycle phase v9 = v2 - 0.2 once the 0.2 gate is passed.
Attack segment (v9 < 0.5): amplitude v5 = 1.0 - (0.5 - v9 + 0.5 - v9), i.e. 1.0 - 2*(0.5 - v9); then TimerClockFormat(v5, 1) and return.
Decay segment (v9 < 2.0): amplitude v7 = 2.0 - v9 + 2.0 - v9, i.e. 2*(2.0 - v9); then TimerClockFormat(v7, 1) and return.
Release-fall segment (v9 < 2.5): amplitude v6 = 1.0 - (2.5 - v9 + 2.5 - v9), i.e. 1.0 - 2*(2.5 - v9); then TimerClockFormat(v6, 0) and return.
Final decay segment (v9 < 4.0): amplitude v7 = 4.0 - v9 + 4.0 - v9, i.e. 2*(4.0 - v9); then TimerClockFormat(v7, 0) and return.
